Visitor replaces highlight/mark with custom template

```typescript title="TypeScript"

function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitMark(ctx: unknown, text: unknown): string | { custom: string } {
        return { custom: `==${text}==` };
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<p>This is a <mark>highlighted passage</mark> in the text.</p>", { visitor: _testVisitor as never });

}
```
